title: 天使队40亿美元易主：曾撤回的出售，为何重启？
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: the price tags just keep getting bigger. What are the details behind this one, Randall?
segments.zh: 价格标签不断刷新。这笔交易背后有什么细节，兰德尔？

segments.en: Yeah, it seems like this was negotiated in the silence of the night.
segments.zh: 是的，这笔交易似乎是在深夜悄然达成的。

segments.en: This was announced yesterday by Crunchy Sports and Entertainment, but it should really come as no surprise.
segments.zh: Crunchy体育娱乐公司昨天宣布了这笔交易，但这并不令人意外。

segments.en: Stan Crunchy owns a franchise and just about every major league, the NFL NBA, MLB, NHL, MLS.
segments.zh: 斯坦·克朗奇拥有各大联赛的球队，包括NFL、NBA、MLB、NHL和MLS。

segments.en: And I believe the Premier League as well. So he is probably the biggest player in all sports.
segments.zh: 我相信还有英超。所以他可能是体育界最大的玩家。

segments.en: Yeah, he is quite the portfolio. In terms of the timing of this sale, it's interesting because what didn't the Moreno family want to put the Angels up for sale,
segments.zh: 是的，他的**组合相当庞大。就出售时机而言，有趣的是莫雷诺家族最初不想出售天使队，

segments.en: and then they didn't follow through on it. Yeah, they put the team up for sale.
segments.zh: 然后他们没有坚持到底。是的，他们确实将球队挂牌出售。

segments.en: I believe in August of 2022 and then pulled the team at the beginning of 2023.
segments.zh: 我记得是在2022年8月，然后在2023年初又撤回了。

segments.en: So I do think that the Padre sale probably had an effect on this, of course, the Padre's were sold for $3.9 billion.
segments.zh: 所以我认为教士队的出售可能对此产生了影响，当然，教士队是以39亿美元出售的。

segments.en: Shortly after that, sometimes what we see in sports is one big sale happens and then everybody else is like, all right, I will sell my team for a little bit less or a little bit more.
segments.zh: 在那之后不久，体育界有时会出现这样的情况：一笔大交易完成后，其他人就会想，好吧，我也卖掉我的球队，价格稍微低一点或高一点。

segments.en: In this case, a little bit more. I mean, Moreno was with this team for 23 years.
segments.zh: 这次有点不同，莫雷诺已经拥有这支球队23年了。

segments.en: Yeah, a long time. Are we expecting like a big strategy shift when Cronky comes in?
segments.zh: 确实很久了。克朗基接手后，会有大的战略调整吗？

segments.en: Listen, Stan Cronky does a lot of strategy shifts. And a lot of his sports things are real estate plays.
segments.zh: 斯坦·克朗基经常进行战略调整，他的体育**很多都涉及地产。

segments.en: And so I do wonder if he will renovate the stadium, if he will rebrand the Los Angeles Angels to the Anaheim Angels, the NFL, of course, has a rule
segments.zh: 我很好奇他是否会翻新球场，把洛杉矶天使队改回阿纳海姆天使队。当然，NFL有规定。

segments.en: that you cannot own a team. I believe it's that you can't own a team in a city of which you have an NFL franchise.
segments.zh: 我认为，你不能在拥有NFL球队的城市再拥有一支球队。

segments.en: Yes, LA Rams. Right, and so I wouldn't be surprised, but we'll see.
segments.zh: 是的，洛杉矶公羊队。所以如果规则改变或他获得豁免，我也不会惊讶。

segments.en: He might be able to get a waiver or something where the rules might change.
segments.zh: 他或许能获得豁免，或者规则可能会改变。
